rules.title: Target Azure region is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submitted evidence does not clearly identify the Azure target region or region-pair strategy.
rules.recommendation: Document target Azure regions and region-pair assumptions. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/reliability/regions-availability-zones.

rules.title: Availability-zone design is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design does not evidence availability zones, zone redundancy, or an explicit non-zone requirement.
rules.recommendation: Document zone redundancy or justify why it is not required. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/reliability/regions-availability-zones.

rules.title: Identity and access model is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence an Entra ID, RBAC, managed identity, PIM, or privileged access model.
rules.recommendation: Document identity, RBAC, managed identity, and privileged access controls. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/identity-access.

rules.title: Privileged access controls are not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design does not evidence PIM, privileged role governance, or least-privilege access review.
rules.recommendation: Add privileged access management and least-privilege role review. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/identity-access.

rules.title: Internet-facing boundary control is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design appears to include public or internet-facing services without evidenced WAF, firewall, Application Gateway, Front Door, APIM, or NSG boundary control.
rules.recommendation: Document boundary protection for public entry points using WAF, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Front Door, APIM, or NSGs. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/networking.

rules.title: Private connectivity is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design does not evidence private endpoints, private DNS, VNet integration, or equivalent private connectivity for platform services.
rules.recommendation: Document private connectivity and DNS design for platform services. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/networking.

rules.title: Backup and disaster recovery strategy is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence backup, restore, DR, RTO, or RPO commitments.
rules.recommendation: Document backup, restore testing, DR pattern, RTO, and RPO. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/reliability/backup-restore.

rules.title: Health and failover behavior is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design does not evidence health probes, retry behavior, failover, or resilience testing.
rules.recommendation: Document health probes, retry policies, failover, and resilience test plans. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/reliability/.

rules.title: Monitoring and alerting are not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, or operational dashboards.
rules.recommendation: Document monitoring, logs, alerts, dashboards, and ownership. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/operational-excellence/monitoring.

rules.title: Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD are not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The design does not evidence Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CI/CD, deployment automation, or runbooks.
rules.recommendation: Document IaC, CI/CD, release controls, and runbooks. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/operational-excellence/infrastructure-as-code-design.

rules.title: Encryption at rest and in transit is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence encryption at rest (storage service encryption, disk encryption, transparent data encryption) or encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+, HTTPS-only). WAF Security 'Protect Confidentiality' requires encryption across all data states.
rules.recommendation: Document encryption strategy: encryption at rest using platform-managed or customer-managed keys (Azure Key Vault), TLS 1.2+ enforcement, HTTPS-only App Service/API configurations, and encrypted backup storage. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/encryption

rules.title: Secrets and key management is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence Azure Key Vault, HSM, or equivalent secrets management. Storing secrets, API keys, connection strings, or certificates outside a managed vault violates WAF Security 'Protect Confidentiality' — guard application secrets.
rules.recommendation: Document Azure Key Vault usage for all secrets, certificates, and cryptographic keys. Ensure no plaintext credentials in configuration or IaC. Use managed identities to eliminate credential use entirely where possible. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/application-secrets

rules.title: Security posture management is not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence Microsoft Defender for Cloud, CSPM tooling, threat detection, or a security posture management strategy. WAF Security principle 'Sustain and evolve your security posture' requires continuous monitoring, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
rules.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud (minimum CSPM free tier). Document threat detection strategy, vulnerability assessment, security alert triage, and Defender for Cloud recommendations remediation. Consider Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM/SOAR. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/security/monitor-threats

rules.title: Cost model and FinOps governance are not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence a cost model, budget allocation, FinOps practices, or cost governance mechanisms. WAF Cost Optimization 'Develop cost-management discipline' requires a cost model, accountability model, and budget to enable financial responsibility and prevent uncontrolled spend.
rules.recommendation: Document a cost model covering TCO estimates, budget with Azure Cost Management alerts, tagging strategy for cost allocation and showback, and FinOps practices. Consider reservations/savings plans for predictable workloads. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/cost-optimization/cost-model

rules.title: Performance targets and scaling strategy are not evidenced
rules.failureMessage: The submission does not evidence performance targets (SLOs, response time, throughput), capacity planning, or an auto-scaling strategy. WAF Performance Efficiency 'Negotiate realistic performance targets' and 'Design to meet capacity requirements' require defined targets and scalable design.
rules.recommendation: Document user-facing SLOs per critical flow, auto-scaling configuration (VMSS, AKS, App Service scale rules), capacity planning assumptions, and a performance testing strategy. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/performance-efficiency/performance-targets
